basic.name: 普通攻击：电击穿
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第三段普通攻击会持续聚集敌人；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以快速穿过前方敌人，最多重复发动5次。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
On the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, enemies are continuously pulled in.
After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

special.name: 特殊技：星雷
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向斜前方快速突进，随后进行交叉斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：极雷断空
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将双剑拼接后向前方丢出进行高速斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodge.name: 闪避：频闪
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：奔流
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方横向斩击后，衔接突刺攻击，造成电属性伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing Electric DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：地闪回击
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；命中敌人时获得15秒[电荷超载]状态，重复获得刷新持续时间；
[电荷超载]状态期间闪避性能提升，且发动[普通攻击]/[冲刺攻击]/[闪避反击]时敌方目标若拥有[白雷]，点按 【特殊技键】 可以随时打断当前招式并发动[特殊技：苍光]；
状态期间点按 【强化特殊技键】 时，若敌人未拥有[白雷]，能直接发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has White Thunder, pressing [Special Attack] will immediately cancel the current skill and launch Special Attack: Azure Flash.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have White Thunder, press [EX Special Attack] to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：疾跃落雷
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方跃起，随后快速俯冲并发动交叉斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：斩空掠电
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连斩，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：云闪
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：逆极反袭
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：直击先导
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进并对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.text:
零号·安比对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；敌方单位被施加[银星]标记后，受到的[追加攻击]暴击伤害额外提升，提升效果等同于零号·安比暴击伤害的30%；[银星]标记期间，受到来自队友的[追加攻击]伤害会为敌方单位累积[银星]充能，该效果5秒内最多触发一次；
[银星]的[追加攻击]暴击伤害提升效果，额外提升零号·安比暴击伤害的5%；拥有[白雷]的敌方目标被击败时，会对最近的敌方目标发动[特殊技：雷殛]。
fields.textEn:
Soldier 0 - Anby deals 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star. When an enemy is afflicted with Silver Star, they take additional CRIT DMG from Aftershocks, equal to 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When marked with a Silver Star, DMG from allies' Aftershocks builds  Silver Star charge on the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
The Aftershock CRIT DMG bonus from Silver Star is further increased by 5% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When an enemy afflicted with White Thunder is defeated, automatically unleash Special Attack: Thunder Smite on the nearest enemy target.

fields.text:
队伍中存在[击破]或[支援]角色时触发：
零号·安比的暴击率提升10%；当前操作中的角色为零号·安比时，全队角色[追加攻击]对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；
零号·安比的[连携技]和[终结技]视为[追加攻击]伤害。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When the current active character is Soldier 0 - Anby, all squad members' Aftershocks deal 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star.
Soldier 0 - Anby's Chain Attack and Ultimate are treated as Aftershock DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：电击穿
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第三段普通攻击会持续聚集敌人；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以快速穿过前方敌人，最多重复发动5次。

ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向斜前方快速突进，随后进行交叉斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：苍光
ex.description:
零号·安比攻击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[银星]标记，并为其进行充能；
每拥有三分之一充能，敌人将被施加1层[白雷]，最多叠加3层；
敌方目标拥有[白雷]时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方位移，穿过敌人并进行斩击，对命中的敌人造成多段电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将消耗1层[白雷]，发动[追加攻击]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the Silver Star mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：雷殛
ex.description:
针对同一名敌人，连续触发3次[白雷]的额外伤害时发动：
在敌方位置降下落雷，对范围内的敌人造成电属性伤害；
该伤害被视为[追加攻击]伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
When the additional damage from White Thunder triggers 3 times on the same enemy:
A lightning strike will fall at the enemy's location, dealing Electric DMG to enemies within range.
This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：苍光·临界（潜能觉醒）
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary (Potential Awakening)
ex.description:
触发[特殊技：雷殛]伤害时：
若正在发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]或[特殊技：苍光]，会在当前招式结束时自动发动[特殊技：苍光·临界]，连续斩击敌人造成多段电属性伤害，招式为[追加攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
When Special Attack: Thunder Smite DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of Electric DMG. This skill counts as an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.trigger: 触发[特殊技：雷殛]伤害时：
fields.triggerEn: When Special Attack: Thunder Smite DMG is triggered:
fields.description:
触发[特殊技：雷殛]伤害时：
若正在发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]或[特殊技：苍光]，会在当前招式结束时自动发动[特殊技：苍光·临界]，连续斩击敌人造成多段电属性伤害，招式为[追加攻击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Special Attack: Thunder Smite DMG is triggered:
If EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt or Special Attack: Azure Flash is currently being used, then Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will automatically trigger when the current skill ends, unleashing a flurry of slashes that deal multiple instances of Electric DMG. This skill counts as an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：极雷断空
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将双剑拼接后向前方丢出进行高速斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 闪避：频闪
fields.trigger: 点按 【闪避键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Dodge] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：奔流
fields.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方横向斩击后，衔接突刺攻击，造成电属性伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a horizontal slash forward, then follow up with a thrust attack, dealing Electric DMG.

fields.name: 闪避反击：地闪回击
fields.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；命中敌人时获得15秒[电荷超载]状态，重复获得刷新持续时间；
[电荷超载]状态期间闪避性能提升，且发动[普通攻击]/[冲刺攻击]/[闪避反击]时敌方目标若拥有[白雷]，点按 【特殊技键】 可以随时打断当前招式并发动[特殊技：苍光]；
状态期间点按 【强化特殊技键】 时，若敌人未拥有[白雷]，能直接发动[强化特殊技：极雷断空]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform consecutive slashes at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG. On hit, gain the Voltage Overload state for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
While in the Voltage Overload state, dodge performance is enhanced. Additionally, when using Basic Attack/Dash Attack/Dodge Counter, if the enemy target has White Thunder, pressing [Special Attack] will immediately cancel the current skill and launch Special Attack: Azure Flash.
While in this state, if the enemy does not have White Thunder, press [EX Special Attack] to directly launch EX Special Attack: Sundering Bolt.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 连携技：疾跃落雷
fields.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
fields.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
fields.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方跃起，随后快速俯冲并发动交叉斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 终结技：斩空掠电
fields.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
fields.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连斩，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 快速支援：云闪
fields.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 招架支援：逆极反袭
fields.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 支援突击：直击先导
fields.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
fields.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前突进并对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 核心被动：电位差
fields.trigger: 零号·安比对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；敌方单位被施加[银星]标记后，受到的[追加攻击]暴击伤害额外提升，提升效果等同于零号·安比暴击伤害的30%；[银星]标记期间，受到来自队友的[追加攻击]伤害会为敌方单位累积[银星]充能，该效果5秒内最多触发一次；
fields.triggerEn: Soldier 0 - Anby deals 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star. When an enemy is afflicted with Silver Star, they take additional CRIT DMG from Aftershocks, equal to 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When marked with a Silver Star, DMG from allies' Aftershocks builds  Silver Star charge on the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
fields.description:
零号·安比对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；敌方单位被施加[银星]标记后，受到的[追加攻击]暴击伤害额外提升，提升效果等同于零号·安比暴击伤害的30%；[银星]标记期间，受到来自队友的[追加攻击]伤害会为敌方单位累积[银星]充能，该效果5秒内最多触发一次；
[银星]的[追加攻击]暴击伤害提升效果，额外提升零号·安比暴击伤害的5%；拥有[白雷]的敌方目标被击败时，会对最近的敌方目标发动[特殊技：雷殛]。
fields.descriptionEn:
Soldier 0 - Anby deals 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star. When an enemy is afflicted with Silver Star, they take additional CRIT DMG from Aftershocks, equal to 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When marked with a Silver Star, DMG from allies' Aftershocks builds  Silver Star charge on the enemy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
The Aftershock CRIT DMG bonus from Silver Star is further increased by 5% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG. When an enemy afflicted with White Thunder is defeated, automatically unleash Special Attack: Thunder Smite on the nearest enemy target.

fields.name: 额外能力：电极化
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在[击破]或[支援]角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
fields.description:
队伍中存在[击破]或[支援]角色时触发：
零号·安比的暴击率提升10%；当前操作中的角色为零号·安比时，全队角色[追加攻击]对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；
零号·安比的[连携技]和[终结技]视为[追加攻击]伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 10%. When the current active character is Soldier 0 - Anby, all squad members' Aftershocks deal 25% more DMG to enemies marked with Silver Star.
Soldier 0 - Anby's Chain Attack and Ultimate are treated as Aftershock DMG.
